record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: When I is generated by generic quadrics and both the generators U of I and a homogeneous presentation matrix V vary over their parameter variety X, does the locus where coker(V) over R = S/I has constant Betti numbers contain a nonempty Zariski open set, and does the locus where coker(V) has constant Betti numbers and a nonperiodic minimal free resolution contain a nonempty Zariski open set?

artifact.category_tag: Generic Poincaré series and free resolutions
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a well-known open-problems list on syzygies and Hilbert functions and is part of the active study of generic behavior of Poincaré series and Betti numbers over rings defined by quadrics. Recent surveys on infinite graded free resolutions continue to list questions of this type as open, with no published resolution found.
